_comment: Per-build hook-point map (design doc §5.3), here for the minimm prototype build. In production TMOS this is emitted by the build pipeline, signed, and shipped alongside the image; a shield resolves its target hook by NAME against this map, and arg_btf carries the typed argument layout the verifier checks a program against. NOTE: field_offsets and ctx_size are authoritative — they must come from the build's debug info, never from re-packing the field list. `make -C substrate check-offsets` asserts them against example_hook_ctx.h; an earlier revision of this file omitted the `mode` field, which silently moved the computed offset of `head` from 12 to 8.

hook_points.name: ls_request_eval_decision
hook_points.abort_branch: host returns LS_DROP/LS_RESET before process_frame() dispatch; no state to unwind (design §6.1)
